text:
maya: Quick copy review — tooltip for the new filter chips on Dashboard. Current tooltip says "Filter by model" which feels vague in context. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/prod/mock.png

alex: I agree, it's ambiguous. Users might think it's filtering navigation or dataset. Maybe be explicit about scope.

dan: From frontend POV we have 40px width on small screens so keep it short. Also tooltips are used on hover/focus so keep accessible phrasing.

noah: A11y note: tooltip should map to aria-describedby for the chip, and text should read naturally with screen readers. Avoid starting with verbs like "Filter" unless it's a button action.

tiago: Suggestions:
- "Filter results by model"
- "Show results for this model"
- "Limit results to this model"

maya: I like "Show results for this model" — reads as a declarative description rather than an instruction. But wondering about tense/clarity when a chip represents "All models" (edge case).

alex: For analytics we also want consistent verbs across tooltips: we use "Show" on filters elsewhere. So aligning is good.

dan: Implementation constraints: tooltip string max 32 chars on mobile before wrapping. "Show results for this model" is 29 chars — OK.

noah: For screen readers maybe expand to "Show results for this model: <model name>" when there's room. If not, SR can append label from chip content. Also avoid punctuation that confuses SRs.

maya: Good call. Proposed final copy:
- visual tooltip (short): "Show results for this model"
- screen reader label (long): "Show results for this model — [MODEL NAME]"

dan: I'll implement with props: 
```
<Tooltip text="Show results for this model" srText={`Show results for this model — ${modelName}`} />
```
Will add responsive truncation.

alex: Also check localization: "Show results for this model" maps cleanly to most locales but confirm with i18n team. @lena (i18n) can we add this to the glossary as a translatable key?

maya: @copybot can you run a quick sweep for other filter tooltip copy to ensure consistency? :eyes:

copybot: Found 6 instances: filter chips (2), sidebar filters (2), table filters (2). Suggested to standardize on "Show results for" pattern.

tiago: Ok let's standardize. Action items: Dan -> PR with tooltip & SR text, Maya -> add ticket to design board for tooltip glossary, Alex -> notify i18n. I'll approve once PR links to design token.

maya: sounds good :thumbsup:

dan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1423 (includes tests for SR mapping)

noah: I'll run accessibility review after PR lands. Quick question — do we want to include role="tooltip"? It sometimes duplicates with aria-describedby.

dan: We'll use aria-describedby and role for the tooltip root per our pattern.

maya: Thanks team. Closing thread once PR is merged. :sparkles:
